false_negative_recoveries.reason: The author closure treated this as a local HOI method, but exact-v1 defines a reusable partial-state authority contract: per-field human locks, bounded machine initiative, atomic rollback and provenance-preserving state transitions.
RMGAP changes the reward-model evaluation contract from one pooled preference to versioned preference dimensions plus ranking consistency under paraphrased preference prompts.

ACDL makes context assembly, time, source namespace, history replay and conditional inclusion explicit system state rather than prompt prose; the mechanism is durable even though the paper is a language/design proposal without controlled outcome evaluation.

The paper changes a deployment evaluation contract: prompt variants, answer-parser success, token confidence, verbal-confidence parseability and calibration must be jointly versioned rather than reporting one canonical-prompt accuracy.
Direct corpus interaction changes the retrieval interface from fixed top-k similarity to agent-controlled local inspection with an explicit breadth/depth and tool-cost envelope.
